Ameerh Naran, visionary entrepreneur and founder of Vimana Private Jets, shares the powerful untold story behind his family’s roots and how their history shaped his success.
In this episode “The Struggle That Forged My Entrepreneurial Empire"
Ameerh Naran takes you on an inspiring journey into Zimbabwe’s history—tracing his family’s migration from India to Southern Rhodesia (now Zimbabwe). items.title: 7 Days: Racing at Imola, Goodwood w/ Pagani & St Tropez
items.description:
In this episode, Ameerh Naran competes in the European Le Mans Series (ELMS) championship in the LMGT3 category, fighting for the podium finish that would help secure his entry into the 24 Hours of Le Mans. The race takes a dramatic turn when an Aston Martin loses control and collides with him, ending his race early and putting his championship campaign in jeopardy, with his only path back now resting on a strong result at the next round in Spa, Belgium.

From the wreckage, Ameerh heads to Forte dei Marmi, Italy to spend time with family, before travelling to the UK ahead of the Goodwood Festival of Speed. Attending as a guest of Pagani, he gets an exclusive, private look at the new Pagani Utopia along with another rare model not yet available to the public, before being invited to a formal ball at Goodwood that evening. The episode ends back on the Mediterranean, with more family time in Saint-Tropez and a final stop in Mykonos.

Ameerh Naran is the CEO and Founder of Vimana Private Jets and the Founder of Naran Automotive, the company behind the world's first four seater hypercar, The Naran. From the racetrack to the paddock to some of the world's most exclusive destinations, this is life through the lens of Ameerh Naran.

items.description:
This video follows Ameerh Naran’s high-octane week in Dubai, blending professional motorsport aspirations with his career as a luxury entrepreneur. From high-speed jet skiing and flyboarding with close friends to deep dives into the mindset required to build a hypercar brand, this vlog offers an unfiltered look at the discipline behind the glamour.

The energy shifts from the boardroom to the Arabian Gulf as Ameerh takes to the water.

Whether it’s hitting top speeds on a jet ski, mastering the flyboard, or navigating a private yacht toward Abu Dhabi, this is about more than just leisure—it’s about the "work from anywhere" philosophy that defines the modern mogul. Behind the sun-drenched lifestyle lies the grit of a professional driver, where every moment of downtime is balanced by the relentless pursuit of peak performance.

Ameerh dives deep into the mental and physical discipline required for his motorsport career. From childhood dreams of winning at Le Mans to the technical reality of training for GT3 racing, he reveals the obsession with precision that fuels both his racing seat and his role as the founder of Naran Automotive.

Watch until the end for candid conversations on financial freedom, the reality of global entrepreneurship, and why for Ameerh Naran, the limit simply does not exist.

items.title: Driving My Pagani Huayra Roadster BC For The First Time
items.description:
This vlog begins at Ellerman House, a luxury boutique hotel overlooking the Atlantic Ocean in Cape Town. From world class art collections to panoramic ocean views, private villas, and one of the most exclusive wine galleries in Africa, Ellerman House sets the tone for a day built around rarity, heritage, and precision.

After the tour, it is time for the moment Ameerh has been waiting for.

The first drive of his Pagani Huayra Roadster BC on South African roads.

Powered by a handcrafted twin turbo V12 built by Mercedes AMG, producing 800 horsepower, the Huayra Roadster BC is one of the most extreme open top hypercars ever created. Carbon fibre everywhere. Active aerodynamics. Exposed titanium exhaust. Every detail engineered for performance and emotion.

Driving this Pagani along the coastal roads of Cape Town is a surreal experience. Ocean cliffs, mountain passes, raw engine sound, and a car that feels more like a piece of mechanical art than transportation.

This is not just a first drive.
It is a milestone moment with one of the rarest cars in the world, in one of the most beautiful locations on earth.

Watch until the end for full driving reactions, sound clips, and the real emotions behind owning and experiencing a Pagani Huayra Roadster BC for the first time.

items.title: The Truth No One Tells You About Aston Martin
items.description:
Step inside the mind of Ameerh Naran as he shares his honest review of the Aston Martin DB9 and reveals why Aston Martin remains one of his all time favourite car brands. From its unmistakable British design to its effortless grand touring performance, Ameerh breaks down what makes the DB9 so special and how it compares to other icons in its class.

In this episode, Ameerh dives into his personal experiences with Aston Martins over the years, discussing the emotional connection, design language, and driving feel that separate Aston from the rest. He compares the DB9 to other cars he has owned and driven, from modern supercars to classic grand tourers, explaining why Aston Martin captures something no other brand can.

Whether you’re an Aston Martin fan, a collector, or simply someone who appreciates luxury engineering, this video delivers rare insight from someone who lives and breathes automotive excellence.

Watch Ameerh’s full review of the Aston Martin DB9 to understand what makes it one of the most beautiful cars ever built, how it stacks up against other GT legends, and why the spirit of Aston Martin continues to inspire his own journey in automotive design and performance.

items.title: Putting The Naran Power Train To The Test
items.description:
Join Ameerh Naran, entrepreneur and founder of Naran Automotive, as he takes you inside a full-throttle journey through sim racing, prototype testing, and competitive motorsport.

This exclusive behind-the-scenes vlog begins in London, where Ameerh trains on a professional-grade racing simulator to prepare for an upcoming competitive race weekend. He shares insights into how virtual racing and simulator technology are helping modern drivers fine-tune their skills before heading to the real track.

From there, the journey moves to Germany, where Ameerh gets behind the wheel of a highly modified BMW test car fitted with the same powerful engine that will be used in the upcoming Naran hypercar. This test marks a key development milestone in the engineering and performance validation of one of the most ambitious hypercars being built today.

Next, Ameerh visits two of the most iconic automotive showrooms in the world — Bugatti and Pagani dealerships in Germany — offering viewers an inside look at some of the rarest and most exclusive hypercars on the market. He discusses design, performance, and how brands like Bugatti and Pagani have influenced his vision for the Naran Automotive brand.

The episode concludes with Ameerh’s race weekend, featuring qualifying sessions and a competitive race. Watch as he takes on experienced racers in a real-world motorsport environment. However, things don’t go entirely to plan. During the race, an unfortunate on-track incident results in contact with another driver, testing Ameerh’s resolve and racecraft under pressure.

This is an unfiltered look at what it takes to build a hypercar brand, test high-performance engineering on the road, and compete in motorsport — all through the lens of one of the most exciting automotive entrepreneurs of this generation.

items.title: ”How Did You Make Your First Million Dollars?”  - Q&A with Ameerh Naran
items.description:
In this episode, Ameerh takes on the drive from Stuttgart to Andermatt, and along the way opens up in one of the most honest Q&A conversations he's ever done on camera. From childhood struggles growing up in Zimbabwe to the pivotal decisions that shaped his career in aviation and now hypercars, Ameerh holds nothing back. He breaks down exactly how much money it actually takes to start a hypercar company, what it took to launch a luxury private jet charter business from zero, and the real story behind his first million dollars. He also gets deeply personal, revealing the lowest point in his life and how he pulled himself out of it, the hardest decisions he's had to make climbing the ladder in both aviation and automotive, and what kind of father he hopes to be one day. Along the way, Ameerh shares the mindset shifts, life advice, and lessons that took him from trading on the playground as a kid to building Naran Automotive and Vimana Private Jets into global brands. Expect raw honesty, unfiltered business advice, and a masterclass in what it actually takes to build something from nothing — all against the backdrop of one of Europe's most stunning drives.

items.title: 7 Days With Baby White Tigers, A Pagani, & A GT3 Race
items.description:
In this week's episode, Ameerh goes from the African bush to the Barcelona circuit, and somehow fits a Pagani in between. 
Zimbabwe. The bush. No phones, no meetings, no noise, just open land and rhinos moving through the grass like they own the earth. Because they do. There is something about standing that close to an animal that has survived everything the world has thrown at it that puts your own ambitions into sharp focus. If they can endure, so can you.
From the wild to the water. This episode takes you to Cape Town next. Table Mountain on one side, the Atlantic on the other, and a city that somehow manages to feel electric and effortless at the same time. This is where the pace shifts. Where the week starts to build.
And then Barcelona.
The circuit. The car. The race. Everything the week has been leading to. In this episode, watch Ameerh compete in GT3 at one of the most iconic tracks in the world, because this is not something you show up for, it is something you earn. Every lap demands total presence. Every corner is a conversation between driver and machine that leaves no room for distraction. After the stillness of the bush and the beauty of Cape Town, this is where everything sharpens to a point.
Three cities. Three completely different worlds. One week that moves from the oldest landscape on earth to the fastest circuit in motorsport, with one of the greatest hypercars ever built somewhere in between.

This is what building a life without limits actually looks like.

Subscribe for more behind the scenes across GT3 racing, hypercar builds, private aviation, and real conversations about what it takes to operate at the highest level.

items.title: Sergio doesn’t love the camera
24 Hours With My Koenigsegg Jesko & Hypercars At Goodwood
items.description:
In this episode, Ameerh takes his Koenigsegg Jesko to the Goodwood Estate rally for the very first time, blasting through the UK countryside on some of Britain's most beautiful roads before arriving at one of the most insane hypercar meetups he has ever been part of.
Along the way he links up with his friend Benjamin, one of the most connected car sourcers in the game, and comes across a truly jaw-dropping McLaren P1 LM in black on black. One of the rarest spec combinations on one of the rarest cars ever produced.
At the rally meeting point, the cars just keep coming. An absolutely unreal lineup of the world's most exclusive hypercars all parked in one spot. Ameerh then heads into the Goodwood car park to let fans get up close to the Jesko and takes in the incredible sight of the full rally rolling through the estate.
He also gets into some real car talk, comparing the Jesko to his Pagani Huayra and Porsche Carrera GT, breaking down what makes each one special and what it actually feels like to drive them back to back.
And Ameerh gets honest about life. Why he stopped investing in other people's businesses, what he has learned from it, and the mindset shifts that changed everything for him.
